cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(SPIKE_AMI_ABI_FIXTURES LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
add_executable(spike-ami-host ../../../src/si/ami_host_main.cpp)
if(NOT WIN32)
  target_link_libraries(spike-ami-host PRIVATE ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS})
endif()
foreach(mode RANGE 0 16)
  add_library(ami_fixture_${mode} SHARED synthetic_model.cpp)
  target_compile_definitions(ami_fixture_${mode} PRIVATE FIXTURE_MODE=${mode})
endforeach()
if(MSVC)
  add_compile_options(/W4 /fp:strict)
else()
  add_compile_options(-Wall -Wextra -fno-fast-math)
endif()
